hypothesis: Diversity pruning filters a distinct candidate list into a new result. Accepted candidates and blocked fill candidates are disjoint, so repeatedly scanning the result for duplicate IDs does no useful work.
scope: A package-private insertion path for known-distinct, non-full destinations; only uncached concurrent pruning uses it. Public duplicate protection and serial cached pruning remain unchanged.
ablations: direct drain plus known-distinct pruning insertion
gates: test fails before implementation, then exact order/raw-score/full-capacity tests pass
at least 5 percent median concurrent construction time reduction on both GLOVE and Fashion-MNIST over three paired seeds for the combined candidate
single-worker graph and query digests equal baseline
every paired held-out recall@10 delta >= -0.005 at ef 32/128/512
real collection replay/recall and all CI checks before merge
no new runtime flags, no reduced M, efConstruction, search budgets or recall gates
